listen_address.description: IPv6 address the server binds to (use '::' for all interfaces).

zone_dir.description: Directory containing IPv6 reverse zone files (e.g., 2001.db, 2001:db8.rev).

query_log_file.description: Path to write query logs (leave blank to disable).

stats_host.description: Bind the stats endpoint to this address (ignored if stats_enabled is false).

zone_refresh_interval.description: Seconds between checks for updated zone files.

upstream_servers.description: List of forwarding rules: forward queries for specific IPv6 prefixes to another resolver.

allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client networks (CIDR notation). Leave empty to allow all.

dnssec_enabled.description: Enable DNSSEC validation for reverse records.
